summary: Build passes and most redesign criteria are met, but four blocking violations remain: hardcoded hex colors in App.tsx and FarmBackground.tsx, an undefined CSS token whose hex fallback is always applied in ExpensesView.tsx, and backend source files were modified despite criterion 8.

findings.issue: Two hardcoded hex color strings added in inline styles: color: "#86efac" and color: "#fff". Criterion 4 forbids hardcoded hex in TSX files; replace with var(--kf-green-300) and var(--kf-surface) or equivalent tokens already defined in tokens.css.

Newly added file contains ~23 hardcoded hex color strings in SVG fill, stroke, and stopColor attributes (e.g. #ffe8a5, #779b69, #263e32, #183f2b, etc.). Criterion 4 forbids hardcoded hex in TSX files; define named CSS variables for each colour and reference them via a CSS class or var().

Inline style uses color: "var(--kf-red-600, #dc2626)" but --kf-red-600 is not defined anywhere in the CSS/token files, so the hardcoded hex fallback #dc2626 is always applied. Criterion 4 forbids hardcoded hex; either define --kf-red-600 in tokens.css or use the already-defined --kf-danger token.

findings.file: backend/src/analytics.ts, backend/src/app.ts, backend/src/config.ts, backend/src/database.ts, backend/src/farmContextStore.ts, backend/src/postgres.ts, backend/src/postgresStore.ts, backend/src/schemas.ts, backend/src/server.ts, backend/src/sqliteStore.ts, backend/src/store.ts
findings.issue: Criterion 8 requires no changes to backend files. The diff shows all listed backend/src/*.ts files modified. Revert these changes or obtain explicit approval before modifying backend source.
